body: OpenStax Contemporary Mathematics, section "11.5 Fairness in Apportionment Methods", prints these objectives: "Describe and illustrate the Alabama paradox." "Describe and illustrate the population paradox." "Describe and illustrate the new-states paradox." "Identify ways to promote fairness in apportionment methods.". This card reports that page.
